resume_projects.heading: Seismic Data Detection
resume_projects.explanation:
Built a seismic data detection solution for the NASA Space Apps Challenge to filter Apollo and Mars InSight seismic data, identify quake signals, and reduce unnecessary noise transmission.

Implemented a signal processing workflow using Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) to separate raw seismometer data into meaningful IMF components and remove noise from seismic signals.

Applied RMS energy calculation to validate signal strength and distinguish useful quake-related patterns from low-value noisy data.

Used PCA-based dimensionality reduction to retain the most important seismic features, followed by Huffman Encoding for efficient and lossless data compression.

Designed a web-app concept to visualize processed seismic data and support future expansion for Mars data analysis and intermittent signal detection.
resume_projects.techStack: Python, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Data Analysis, Signal Processing, EMD, RMS Energy Calculation, PCA, Huffman Encoding, Seismic Data Processing, Web App Visualization
